name: Wink Danang Centre, Unscripted by Hyatt
short_description: A 244-room boutique hotel in downtown Hai Chau with a guaranteed 24-hour stay, Dragon Bridge views, and TripAdvisor's #1 ranking among Hai Chau hotels.
ai_summary: Wink Danang Centre sits on Tran Phu Street in downtown Hai Chau, within walking distance of Han Market, the Pink Cathedral, and the Dragon Bridge, and joined World of Hyatt as part of the Unscripted by Hyatt collection when Hyatt's December 2025 partnership with Wink Hotels took effect. Its signature feature is a guaranteed 24-hour stay -- guests can check in any time and check out exactly 24 hours later -- alongside a 24/7 gym, laundromat, co-working space, and a Wink Kitchen serving street food. Guests consistently praise the central location, Dragon Bridge night views from upper floors, and attentive staff, ranking the hotel #1 of 9 in Hai Chau on TripAdvisor with a 5-of-5 rating; a handful of reviews mention the property not always feeling perfectly clean despite daily housekeeping.

faqs.question: What does the '24-hour stay' at Wink Danang Centre mean?
faqs.answer: Guests can check in at any time of day and check out exactly 24 hours later, rather than being tied to a fixed check-in/check-out time -- a signature feature across Wink's Unscripted by Hyatt properties in Vietnam.

faqs.question: When did Wink Danang Centre join World of Hyatt?
faqs.answer: It joined as part of the Unscripted by Hyatt collection when Hyatt's partnership with Wink Hotels took effect on December 1, 2025, converting Wink's existing Vietnam properties into Hyatt-branded hotels.
